en.headline: Loose dog runs from Tin Hau onto harbour bypass
en.dek: A two-year-old white mixed-breed escaped near the waterfront on Thursday afternoon and was later found with an injured front leg inside the Central–Wan Chai Bypass.
body: A pet dog ran onto the Island Eastern Corridor and into the Central–Wan Chai Bypass on Thursday afternoon after slipping away from its walker, police said.

Officers told Hong Kong 01 they received a report at 5.02 p.m. that a domestic helper walking a two-year-old white mixed-breed female dog at the Tin Hau waterfront near Hing Fat Street had lost control of the animal. The dog entered the eastbound Central–Wan Chai Bypass near the Wan Chai North entrance. Passing drivers slowed and called police.

Staff and officers later caught the dog inside the tunnel. The Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals found an injury to its right front leg and took it to a centre for treatment. The owner was later contacted and went to the centre.
Video circulating on social media showed the dog running between vehicles during the evening peak. No collision involving a person was reported.

zh.headline: 北角海濱小狗失控竄入東廊及繞道 右前肢受傷被救回
zh.dek: 警方指外傭周四傍晚在天后海濱遛狗期間犬隻走失，跑入中環灣仔繞道，愛協其後發現右前肢受傷並聯絡狗主。
body: 一隻寵物犬周四下午由北角海濱一帶走失，跑上東區走廊再進入中環灣仔繞道，途經司機減速及報案。
警方回覆查詢時表示，下午5時02分接報，有外傭帶同一隻兩歲白色混種雌性犬前往天后海濱長廊近興發街，其間犬隻失控跑走，進入中環灣仔繞道東行近灣仔北入口。
人員其後在管道內截獲小狗。愛護動物協會發現牠右前肢受傷，帶返中心治理，並成功聯絡狗主到場了解。
社交平台流傳片段顯示小狗在下班高峰時段於車陣中奔跑。暫未有報稱有人因事件受傷。
